$comment: Clip look (plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-clip-music-name-transitions.md, D408/D411; user 2026-11-20: 'need more options ... and a randomise these effects options in settings'). Each reel gets one seeded pick of music mode, transition set and name style from the user's ticks in <data>/settings.json clips.look (Settings > Clips > Clip look). Read by services/clip/clip_look.py and services/studio-ui/user-settings.mjs (same rules). A lock always uses its one choice; randomise off uses the first tick. An empty tick list switches that part off. The last picks live in <data>/clips/look-history.json; a pick never repeats the last historyN of its group while another tick is free. Behind the flag clip-look (on: the user asked for it).

options.label: Start and end
options.about: Music under the first seconds and the last seconds, cut on its beats.

options.label: Drop on the big moment
options.about: The track's drop lands on the strongest kill; the music runs under the whole clip, quieter while the game is loud.

options.label: Under the whole clip
options.about: Music under the whole clip, quieter while the game is loud.

options.label: Punchy gaming
options.about: Fast zooms and slides with a whoosh and a hit on each join.

options.label: Cinematic
options.about: Slower fades through black and soft wipes with a riser and a low boom.

options.label: Clean / minimal
options.about: Short soft fades with a light whoosh.

options.label: Lower third
options.about: A coloured bar slides in at the bottom and your name types on over it.

options.label: Corner tag
options.about: A small badge with your name in a corner, the whole clip.

options.label: Kinetic text reveal
options.about: Big letters pop in one by one in the upper third, no box.
